text:
Aj Patel: Heads up — seeing ~120 duplicate refund line items on today's nightly invoice run for acct acct_8923. They show as two refunds applied for the same Stripe refund id.
Nina Gomez: omg that's bad. are charges duplicated on customer's CC or just NetSuite?
Aj Patel: Customers were credited twice in NetSuite only; Stripe shows only one refund id r_1JkABCdE. NetSuite invoice has two credit memos.
Samir Chen: any recent deploys?
deploy-bot: deploy finished: release/2026-03-22-12:31 UTC by @devon
Devon (eng-infra): we rolled a proxy header normalization change to strip/normalize some incoming headers earlier this morning.
Nina Gomez: could header normalization affect our webhook signature verification?
Samir Chen: yes — looks like the proxy was normalizing the header name from "X-Signature" to "x-signature" which our verifier was doing a case-sensitive lookup for. If verification failed, the webhook handler enqueues for replay. Our replay path ends up computing an idempotency key that included header values, so casing differences produce a different key.
Aj Patel: logs: 
```
ERROR billing:webhook_handler - signature verification failed for webhook id evt_1JkABCdE headers: {"x-signature":"sha256=..."}
INFO billing:webhook_processor - enqueued for replay id evt_1JkABCdE replay_attempt=1
INFO netsuite-sync - created credit_memo CM-1234 for refund r_1JkABCdE
INFO netsuite-sync - created credit_memo CM-1235 for refund r_1JkABCdE (replayed)
```
Devon (eng-infra): confirming — the gateway rewrite was intended to normalize some legacy headers, but it unintentionally changed casing for our HMAC header. Our gateway logs show header rewrite at 1717890600.
Samir Chen: root cause = header name normalization + idempotency hash including non-stable headers. Fix plan: 1) make signature lookup case-insensitive, 2) compute idempotency using stable fields (event id + refund id) only, 3) revert header normalization in gateway.
Nina Gomez: we need a remediation plan for already-duplicated credit memos. Can we auto-void the duplicate ones?
Aj Patel: finance can run a backfill script: find credit memos with same external_refund_id and amount created within 5 minutes, void the later one and create an audit note. Will need approval for auto-void for up to 200 affected customers.
Samir Chen: I'll open a PR for the verifier/idempotency changes and add unit+integration tests.
Devon (eng-infra): rolling hotfix to gateway to preserve header casing and removed the normalization rule now. Will monitor.
billing-bot: Created ticket #BILL-4572: "Webhook signature header normalization caused duplicate NetSuite credit memos" assigned to Samir Chen, due 2026-03-22 EOD
Nina Gomez: approving backfill script for up to 200 customers. @finance-approvals please rubber stamp.
Aj Patel: thanks all. I'll run the backfill after Devon confirms hotfix fully rolled and Samir's patch merged. :thumbsup:
Devon (eng-infra): hotfix deployed @ 1717891800, gateway logs look normal.
Samir Chen: PR merged, added deterministic idempotency calculation (event_id + refund_id).
Aj Patel: backfill scheduled 1717893600. posting results in updates channel after run. Closing thread for now.
